description: The line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is linear and ranges from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," is also linear and ranges from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The plot features three lines: a dashed blue line representing the sparsity ratio before gate, an orange dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after gate, and a green dash-dot line representing the sparsity ratio after average gate. The blue line starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.8 and decreases steadily to about 0.2 by layer 20. The orange line starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.6 and decreases to about 0.2 by layer 20. The green line starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.4 and decreases to about 0.2 by layer 20.
